ratings.comment: Lectures were practically useless, the pandemic lecture recordings on Canvas were much clearer and easier to understand. Lecture is rushed through, showing formulas for a few seconds and then straight into solving, with a lot of missing steps and a lack of explanations. Questions were rarely answered directly. 87% of grade are exams.

Class wasn't terrible, but it definitely took me time to understand the material at the beginning. (I haven't read the textbook once this semester) Do the practice tests and you should be fine. Once you get to vectors it's not bad at all.

This class was the bane of my existence freshman year. During the lectures I could not understand anything he was saying and would move on way too quickly. Even during the discussion sessions where I am supposed to ask questions, I was not able to because I could not understand my TA either. Never take this class unless you have to.

Lectures were basically useless and just went through examples, skipping steps along the way that made it hard to follow along. He bases his class off of our ability to read the textbook, which we have other things to be doing.
